### Summary
  * The highest-paid actors of 2024 included familiar names like Dwayne Johnson and Jerry Seinfeld, who earned millions through new projects and ongoing syndication deals that continue to generate revenue. 
  * Nicole Kidman was the only actress to feature in the top 10, while Kevin Hart’s work across multiple platforms, including film, streaming, and live performances, brought in $81 million. 
  * Ryan Reynolds capitalized on a packed schedule to earn $85 million, and Dwayne Johnson’s revenue from two feature films helped him reach $88 million, making him the highest-paid actor of 2024. 


The highest-paid actors of 2024 played their roles on screen and worked just as hard behind the scenes, negotiating multimillion-dollar deals before a single frame was shot. Earnings are no longer tied strictly to acting, as [backend profits](https://beverlyboy.com/filmmaking/what-is-backend-compensation-in-film/), streaming contracts, and global licensing agreements dictate who takes home the biggest checks. Studios are not just paying for performances; they are investing in actors who bring audience engagement, global recognition, and built-in marketing power.
To maximize earnings, top names secure multi-film contracts, streaming exclusives, and revenue-sharing agreements that guarantee payouts upfront and long after a film's release. The top-earning stars of 2024 feature familiar names like [Dwayne Johnson](https://www.therichest.com/celebnetworth/athletes/wrestler/the-rock-dwayne-johnson-net-worth/) and Jerry Seinfeld, who continue to cash in from new projects and past hits that still generate revenue through syndication and residuals. Let's take a look at the highest-paid actors of 2024, the blockbuster roles and deals that padded their bank accounts with millions.

##  10  Will Smith 
![Will Smith](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/will-smith.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $26 Million 
Will Smith returned to his old stomping grounds with _Bad Boys: Ride or Die_ , and the payday made it all the sweeter. Industry debates still surround his full recovery after the [2022 Oscars incident](https://www.billboard.com/lists/will-smith-chris-rock-oscars-slap-timeline/), but the numbers speak for themselves. The fourth installment in the action-comedy franchise [brought in $404 million worldwide](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/title/tt4919268/?ref_=bo_se_r_3), proving that audiences still show up when his face is on the poster.
Studios still see value in his name, particularly when he returned to the series that made him a household name in the 1990s and early 2000s. Smith’s earnings for the year reached $26 million, a figure driven mainly by his deal for _Bad Boys: Ride or Die_. Will Smith currently has a net worth of $350 million. Years of box office dominance, [blockbuster contracts](https://www.therichest.com/will-smith-movies/), and a deep catalog of past hits have made him a studio’s safest bet, guaranteeing blockbuster returns with every release.
##  9  Adam Sandler 
![Adam Sandler](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/adam-sandler.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Depositphotos
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $26 Million 
A deal like Adam Sandler’s with Netflix is not something you see every day. It allows him to swing between mainstream crowd-pleasers like the upcoming _Happy Gilmore 2_ and smaller, more introspective projects. The partnership has made him one of the [most valuable names on the platform](https://www.thethings.com/heres-how-adam-sandler-landed-his-250-million-deal-with-netflix/), drawing millions of viewers to his new releases and his extensive back catalog. In 2024, he starred in _Spaceman_ , the film took him outside his usual comedy roles, giving audiences a deeper look at his dramatic range.
He also dropped his Netflix stand-up special, _Adam Sandler: Love You_ , which brought in millions of views. With these projects, he pulled in $26 million in 2024. Sandler was the [best-paid actor in 2023](https://www.therichest.com/adam-sandler-highest-paid-actor/), earning $73 million, and though his 2024 total took a dip, his Netflix contract keeps him playing in the major leagues. Sandler’s movies have [collectively grossed over $2 billion](https://www.therichest.com/rich-powerful/the-10-highest-grossing-adam-sandler-movies-as-of-2023/), and he has a net worth of $440 million.

##  8  Nicole Kidman 
![Nicole Kidman](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/nicole-kidman.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $31 Million 
Nicole Kidman stayed booked and busy in 2024, and she was handsomely rewarded for every second on screen. She headlined a string of streaming projects in 2024, including _The Perfect Couple_ and _A Family Affair_ on Netflix, _Lioness_ on Paramount+, and _Expats_ on Amazon, making a [reported $1 million per episode](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/how-hbos-big-little-lies-stars-leveraged-apple-big-paydays-1075169/) in each. The Academy Award winner also had a busy year on the big screen.
Kidman starred opposite Harris Dickinson in the erotic thriller _Babygirl._ The film [grossed $63.8 million worldwide](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/title/tt30057084/?ref_=bo_se_r_1) on a $20 million budget. She also voiced a character in _Spellbound_ , which had a limited theatrical release before hitting Netflix. Nicole Kidman earned $31 million in 2024, balancing streaming contracts with major film roles. A résumé stacked with award-winning performances, box office hits, and [brand partnerships](https://www.smh.com.au/entertainment/nicole-swings-12m-deal-for-chanel-no-5-20031027-gdhnwi.html) explains why she has a net worth of $250 million.
##  7  George Clooney 
![George Clooney](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/george-clooney.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $31 Million 
A face that sells tickets and a name that turns films into events, George Clooney has mastered the art of making studios reach deep into their pockets while audiences line up in droves to watch him do what he does best. He was at the heart of the conversation in 2024, voicing the Spaceman in the fantasy comedy film _IF_ alongside [Ryan Reynolds](https://www.therichest.com/ryan-reynolds-net-worth/) and delivering another dynamic performance with Brad Pitt in the spy thriller _Wolfs_. The former [grossed over $190.3 million](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/title/tt11152168/?ref_=bo_se_r_1) against a budget of $110 million.
_The New York Times_ reported that Apple paid Clooney and Pitt [more than $35 million](https://www.nytimes.com/2024/08/25/business/media/apple-movies-theaters-wolfs.html) to star, but the Academy Award-winning actor [dismissed the report](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/george-clooney-brad-pitt-salary-wolfs-film-venice-1235989067/), calling such figures “ _bad for our industry if that’s what people think is the standard bearer for salaries._ ” The film became a streaming battleground before its release, with platforms competing to add it to their libraries. Apple’s aggressive bidding war for the film highlighted its confidence in the project’s profitability. George Clooney’s movies have [collectively grossed over $4 billion](https://www.therichest.com/george-clooney-movies/) worldwide, while his net worth is estimated at $500 million.

##  6  Brad Pitt 
![Brad Pitt](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/brad-pitt.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $32 Million 
Brad Pitt covered all his bases in 2024, balancing streaming exclusives and theatrical releases, and his annual earnings proved he played his cards right. He starred in _Wolfs_ opposite longtime friend George Clooney while also sneaking in a voice cameo in the animated film _IF_. Pitt's Plan B Entertainment was firing on all cylinders, [staying busy behind the scenes](https://www.the-numbers.com/movies/production-company/Plan-B-Entertainment) and shaping some of the year's most notable productions.
The company played a key role in bringing _Beetlejuice Beetlejuice_ to audiences, a [major commercial success](https://www.therichest.com/beetlejuice-beetlejuice-2-cast/). Plan B Entertainment produced _Nickel Boys_ , which earned a Best Picture nomination. Pitt also executive-produced _Bob Marley: One Love_ and the hit series _Outer Range_. Brad Pitt earned $32 million in 2024, pulling in top dollar from starring roles and the projects he helped bring to life. Pitt's movies have [collectively grossed around $6.9 billion](https://www.therichest.com/brad-pitt-highest-grossing-movies/) at the global box office, and his net worth is currently estimated to be $400 million.
##  5  Hugh Jackman 
![Hugh Jackman](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/hugh-jackman.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $50 Million 
Not many actors get the chance to retire a character with dignity, let alone return to it in a record-shattering blockbuster. Hugh Jackman returned to the big screen in 2024 for one reason: _Deadpool & Wolverine_. The film became the [highest-grossing R-rated movie](https://www.therichest.com/highest-grossing-r-rated-movies/) of all time, grossing over $1.3 billion worldwide. In North America alone, it brought in $636.7 million, with another $701.3 million pouring in from international markets.
Jackman had bid farewell to the character in 2017’s _Logan_ , a send-off praised for its emotional depth. Yet, the promise of a blockbuster paycheck and the chance to reunite with close friend Ryan Reynolds was enough to convince him to unsheathe the claws one more time. The decision paid off, as _Deadpool & Wolverine_ became the [biggest box office win](https://www.therichest.com/hugh-jackman-movies-highest-grossing/) of his career. Hugh Jackman has a net worth of $100 million, a clear sign that he has [mastered the art of excelling](https://www.therichest.com/hugh-jackmans-net-worth/) in action films and theater.

##  4  Jerry Seinfeld 
![Jerry Seinfeld](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/jerry-seinfeld.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $60 Million 
Comedy has been good to Jerry Seinfeld, so good that he still collects eight-figure checks from a show that ended decades ago. The comedian pulls in $30 million every year from _Seinfeld_ reruns, with syndication agreements fueling a [total revenue stream of $465 million](https://www.mensjournal.com/news/jerry-seinfeld-earnings-seinfeld-show). Even at 70, he keeps his stand-up career alive with regular tours that pin his name and his net worth in the spotlight. In 2024, Seinfeld took on multiple roles in _Unfrosted_ , the Netflix satire [about the creation of Pop-Tarts](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/jerry-seinfeld-unfrosted-reviews-netflix-1235889540/).
He co-wrote, directed, produced, and starred in the comedy, sharing the screen with Melissa McCarthy and [Hugh Grant](https://www.therichest.com/rich-powerful/how-hugh-grant-became-a-hollywood-star/). The film highlighted his signature humor and ability to turn the most mundane topics into engaging storytelling. _Bloomberg_ officially recognized him as a billionaire in 2024, crediting his vast earnings from streaming deals, stand-up specials, and backend profits. Jerry Seinfeld currently has a [net worth of over $1 billion](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-03-22/jerry-seinfeld-net-worth-tops-1-billion-thanks-to-sitcom), making him [one of the richest celebrities](https://www.therichest.com/richest-actors/).
##  3  Kevin Hart 
![Kevin Hart](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/kevin-hart.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $81 Million 
Kevin Hart treats entertainment like a marathon with no finish line. No one worked [across more platforms than Hart](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0366389/), who racked up screen time in film, television, streaming, podcasts, and live shows. He starred in _Borderlands_ on the big screen, headlined _Lift_ on Netflix, and led _Die Hart 2: Die Harter_ on Amazon Prime. Television commitments included _Die Hart_ season three on the Roku Channel and _Fight Night_ on Peacock. And if that was not enough, he hosted Netflix’s _Roast of Tom Brady_ and ran a weekly podcast, _Gold Minds_ , for Spotify.
Even his commercial partnerships with DraftKings and Chase made sure he never left the public eye, though those deals were not factored in his official earnings. Then came the live grind. Hart performed 90 stand-up shows, filling arenas with his signature rapid-fire delivery. Through his relentless work ethic, the Grammy Award-nominated comedian pulled in $81 million in 2024. Kevin Hart has a [net worth of $450 million](https://www.therichest.com/kevin-hart-net-worth/), and there is every reason to believe that he will land on the next highest-paid actors list.

##  2  Ryan Reynolds 
![Ryan Reynolds](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/ryan-reynolds.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $85 Million 
The formula for box office gold was no mystery in 2024, as Ryan Reynolds perfected the balance of action, humor, and commercial appeal. He headlined _Deadpool & Wolverine_, not just as its star but also as a producer and co-writer. The film was wildly successful as it scored over $1.3 billion at the global box office, making it the second-[highest-grossing film of 2024](https://www.therichest.com/2024-movies/). The long-awaited return of his wisecracking antihero turned out to be his most financially rewarding project yet. Balancing the absurd with the heartfelt, he also starred in _IF_ , a John Krasinski-directed fantasy that [collected $190 million](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/title/tt11152168/?ref_=bo_se_r_1) globally.
Off-screen, his production company continued rolling out content, including a new season of _Welcome to Wrexham_ for Hulu, documenting his time as a soccer club owner. Reynolds turned a packed calendar into pure profit, walking away with an estimated $85 million. In all, he has starred in over 50 films, which have [collectively grossed over $8 billion](https://www.therichest.com/ryan-reynolds-movies-highest-grossing/) worldwide. As of 2025, Ryan Reynolds has a net worth of $350 million, fueled by decades of box office success and a sharp eye for profitable investments.
##  1  Dwayne Johnson 
![Dwayne Johnson](https://static0.therichestimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/dwayne-johnson.jpg?q=70&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1) Via Instar Images
###  Total Earnings In 2024 (Reported): $88 Million 
Not every blockbuster sets the world on fire, but Dwayne Johnson has a habit of turning his projects into pure spectacle. He first teased _Red One_ on Instagram in 2021, fueling anticipation for three years before its November 2024 release. The holiday action film landed with lukewarm reviews and a [box office return of $186 million](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/title/tt14948432/?ref_=bo_se_r_1), well below its reported $250 million budget, but Johnson kept his foot on the gas. He maintained the film’s visibility, pushing it across social media and rallying his audience. When _Red One_ hit Amazon Prime Video a month later, it pulled in a [record-breaking 50 million viewers](https://deadline.com/2024/12/red-one-prime-video-viewership-record-1236205237/) in its opening weekend.
Johnson’s deal for _Red One_ was one for the record books. It included acting and producing fees plus a buyout of backend profits, bringing his earnings for the film to $50 million, making it the highest ever for a single contract. On top of that, revenue from _Moana 2_ and the profits rolling in from his older films helped push his earnings to an estimated $88 million last year, becoming the highest-paid actor of 2024. [Dwayne Johnson](https://www.therichest.com/dwayne-johnson-net-worth/) has a net worth of $800 million, and it is easy to see why.
